provider_selection_notes.selection_reason: Quartr edited transcripts expose speaker mapping with name, role, and company affiliation and document an explicit transcript availability SLA, which better preserves the issuer-evidence/analyst-exclusion correctness invariant than a role-opaque transcript fallback.
provider_selection_notes.financial_modeling_prep: Not selected for the frozen fallback slot at this stage. FMP documents a self-service earnings transcript endpoint, but its public transcript documentation does not provide the same explicit speaker-role/company mapping contract needed by the current provenance filter.
provider_selection_notes.finnhub: Technically viable contingency because its premium transcript response documents participant roles and sessions, but transcript access is an add-on/contact-sales product and is not selected while Quartr remains the preferred structured fallback.
provider_selection_notes.quartr_access: Pricing is contact-sales. Selecting the provider in this draft does not authorize purchase and does not make v2 executable.

notes: Draft design only. The multi-source architecture is selected, with Alpha Vantage primary and Quartr edited transcripts as the preferred fallback. Freeze a separate executable v2 contract only after Quartr access terms are accepted, exact cases/windows and blind ranking rubric are frozen, and the fallback resolver is wired into the v2 collection path. Frozen v1 remains unchanged.
